name: comp-143
title: Right Aligned Card Checkbox
blurb: Card-style checkbox with label and description, aligned to the right.
description: Right-aligned checkbox card with label, sublabel, and description using flex order reordering. Similar to comp-141 but with right alignment.
use_when: Card-based selections where the checkbox sits on the right.
avoid_when: Breaking standard form conventions—left alignment is expected.
a11y: Checkbox and description properly linked via aria-describedby. Order doesn't affect keyboard navigation. Full accessibility.
